subject: Hide standing harness drain wrappers from frontier projection
description: Standing harness drain wrappers (followup/harness-judge-drain, followup/harness-label-drain, followup/harness-learner-drain) are daemon/headless-owned and should not appear in the interactive frontier/dashboard projection. Keep them excluded from interactive heartbeat spawning, and additionally filter them from GET /state?scope=frontier / get_graph(scope=frontier). Add focused tests proving frontier projection omits them while retaining normal ready tasks and while preserving daemon/headless drain ownership.
